title: Play and curiosity
description: Yoru touching things himself. The things are the site's own (a Pile piece, a ledge, something hanging in a project window), so they are never drawn: he aims at a fixed spot in front of him and the resident places the real object there. Wolf, 2026-10-24: inspect and poke, nudge off a ledge, bat at dangling things.

clips.action: Yoru inspects a small object lying on the ground just in front of him, towards the left edge of the image. The object itself is NOT drawn: the ground in front of his feet stays empty background, and his nose and claw stop exactly at that empty spot. He faces the left edge of the image in three-quarter view the whole time. Curious, careful, then satisfied that it is harmless.
beats: Standing upright, looking down at the empty spot on the ground in front of him, ears forward.
Leaning down towards the spot, neck stretched, tail up for balance.
Sniffing the spot closely, nose almost touching it, eyes narrowed.
One front paw reaching out, a single claw poking the spot.
Pulling the paw back quickly and leaning back half a step, ears flicking.
Head tilted, studying the spot, a sceptical look.
Poking the spot a second time, more confidently.
Straightening up, unimpressed and satisfied, as if he knew all along.

clips.action: Rare, earned mischief. Yoru stands right at the very edge of a ledge; a small object lies on the ledge directly in front of his front toes, at his feet. The object is NOT drawn. Holding eye contact with the viewer, he pushes it off the edge with one front paw, and the push must be clearly readable: he crouches low with his chest near the ground, so his front leg, at its natural short length, reaches forward and down past his toes and over the brink. The leg never stretches or grows; the crouch and lean give the reach. Body in three-quarter view facing the left edge of the image, head turned to the viewer.
beats: Standing at the edge, front toes at the brink, body towards the left edge of the image, head turned to look straight at the viewer.
Lowering into a crouch, chest dropping towards the ledge, still looking at the viewer.
Crouched low, one front paw lifted and bent, hovering over the empty spot just in front of his toes.
Paw pressed down on the empty spot in front of his toes, leaning his weight onto it, a tiny smirk.
Still crouched, paw pushing forward to the very brink of the ledge, clearly in front of his other paw.
Paw reaching down over the brink, toes pointing down past the edge, leg its normal length; nothing is drawn there.
Rising out of the crouch, paw back beside the other one, glancing down over the edge after whatever fell.
Standing tall again, looking back at the viewer, half-lidded and smug.

clips.action: Yoru sits and lazily bats at something hanging just above and in front of him, towards the left edge of the image. The hanging thing is NOT drawn: that spot stays empty background. He watches it swing with his head, bats once more, then loses interest. Seated in three-quarter view facing the left edge of the image.
beats: Seated, looking up at the empty spot above and in front of him, ears forward.
Lifting one front paw towards it.
Batting upwards, paw at the empty spot, claws just out.
Paw back down, head following the swing to the left.
Head following the swing back to the right.
Paw lifting again, eyes narrowed.
Batting a second time, a little harder.
Paw down, looking away, lost interest, unimpressed.
